_comment: Workbook exercise plant-boiler (docs/workbook/plant-boiler.md): the four point-in-time hot-water plant rules on the lbnl-boiler plant. hw_pump_dp_reset (the dataset template's one rule; fixed near-full / near-minimum bands) reads pump 1's speed and the loop DP setpoint. boiler_summer_lockout (default 65 F lockout), boiler_short_cycle (default 6 starts a day) and hw_plant_deltat need to know when the boiler fired. This plant has no boiler run status: BOI_STA_1 is the boiler enable, 1 all year, and is deliberately left unmapped (see the data issues). Since 0.98 the three rules read firing from boiler 1's gas input instead (gas_input_rate above 5% of its own 95th percentile; run_source gas, with a caveat): the exercise asks what that fallback can and cannot see. Boiler fouling needs the boiler drift family (boiler_efficiency_drift, a baseline-vs-current comparison of one boiler), which a per-run dataset cannot feed through a config.
